title: Agent renames an API response field and misses a consumer that calls the route by URL string

request.text: Rename the status field to state in the GET api/orders/{id} response and tell me everything that has to change with it.

expected: The agent searches for the route string as well as the type, and lists both consumers with path:line: web/admin/src/app/orders/order.service.ts and apps/shop/lib/order-status.ts. Callers outside the repository are reported as unknown.
observed: The agent searched only for the Order interface, listed the admin service, and said it was the only consumer. apps/shop/lib/order-status.ts, which reads body.status, was missed.

steps: Copy the fixture to a fresh disposable directory with a local git repository and no remote.
After explicit opt-in, load the plugin in that copy and send the request text once, in a new session, with read-only tools.
Keep the stream-json transcript, redact it with --redact, read it in full, and score it with --score --case FC-0002.

rootCause.summary: Consumers were found by type or symbol search only. A caller that uses the route string and an untyped body shares no symbol with the API.

correctiveAction.summary: If a live replay reproduces the failure, make the route-string search an explicit step for response-shape changes in the impact recipe; then re-run the replay on the changed revision.
